title: The Dynamic Breakout II Strategy
origin: QuantConnect Tutorials 04 Strategy Library/04; Pruitt 1996 (Futures Magazine), Building Winning Trading Systems
mechanism: volatility-adaptive lookback (20-60 days) HH/LL breakout + Bollinger confirmation, daily bars, FX in the tutorial
author_reported: EURUSD/GBPUSD backtests, no stats quoted here
transfer: daily breakout family; in-house 15-min breakout/opening-range grids (hundreds of thousands) already cover adaptive-lookback breakouts -> duplicate, not re-tested

title: Dual Thrust Trading Algorithm
origin: QuantConnect Tutorials 04 Strategy Library/05; Michael Chalek
mechanism: open +/- k * range(HH-LC, HC-LL over N days) intraday breakout bands
transfer: opening-range/ATR breakout family already saturated in-house (MNQ_BRK_E is the surviving member) -> duplicate

title: Intraday ETF Momentum
origin: QuantConnect Tutorials 04 Strategy Library/1026; Gao, Han, Li, Zhou (2018) JFE 129(2) 394-414
mechanism: first half-hour return (incl. overnight) predicts last half-hour return of SPY and other ETFs; stronger on high-vol / high-volume / macro-news days
author_reported: paper: significant predictive R2 for SPY 1993-2013; QC tutorial narrows universe to SPY/IWM/IYR to improve backtest (selection)
transfer: directly testable on MES/MNQ 15-min bars inside the funded day session (enter 15:30, flat 15:55). Novel vs in-house ledger (no last-half-hour mechanism recorded) -> ROUND 4

title: Overnight Anomaly
mechanism: buy close, sell open (overnight return premium)
author_reported: QC notes the edge is eaten by fees with IB model
transfer: holding overnight is prohibited by LucidFlex rules -> not tradeable here; a day-session mirror (fade of overnight gap) belongs to the gap family already tested

title: Turn of the Month in Equity Indexes
mechanism: long index from last trading day of month through first 3 days
transfer: testable as day-session-only long bias (09:30-15:55 on TOM days) and as a calendar filter on the deployed sleeves -> ROUND 5 (calendar effects), low priority: multi-day effect mostly accrues overnight

title: Pre-Holiday Effect
mechanism: long SPY on the 1-2 trading days before an exchange holiday
transfer: day-session version testable (~9 days/yr -> tiny sample) -> ROUND 5 bundle

title: Option Expiration Week Effect
origin: QuantConnect Tutorials 04 Strategy Library/102; Stivers & Sun
mechanism: large-cap index returns higher in monthly OpEx week
transfer: calendar filter on sleeves / day-session long bias -> ROUND 5 bundle

title: VIX Predicts Stock Index Returns
mechanism: long index when VIX in top 2-year percentiles, short when in bottom
transfer: regime filter for sleeves (needs free CBOE VIX daily history, point-in-time = prior close) -> backlog

title: Momentum and State of Market Filters
mechanism: cross-sectional stock momentum switched off when broad-market trailing return is negative
transfer: cross-sectional equities; only the regime-switch idea transfers (already implicit in sleeves' trend filters) -> catalogued

title: Short Term Reversal with Futures
mechanism: weekly cross-sectional reversal across 24 futures conditioned on volume change
transfer: needs a 24-market universe and weekly holds -> not applicable to a two-instrument day-session account
